segments.text: A red light. On a very, very steep hill.
And right behind you: a lorry. Full of watermelons. Ten thousand of them. What do you do?
Most drivers let the clutch out too fast, and roll back.
Big mistake. Bonk! The lorry wobbles. And ten thousand watermelons jump into the air.
They all come down on you. Splat! Splat! Splat! Now your car is a fruit salad. And the light? Still red.
Here's how you do it properly.
Handbrake on. And ask the lorry driver for just one watermelon.
Karate chop it in half, and put the halves behind your back wheels. The world's juiciest wheel chocks.
Green light. Gas, handbrake off, and up you go. Not one centimetre back.
And the lorry driver gets the chocks back. As lunch.
Next exam question: a duck crosses the road, with endless ducklings. Follow, so you don't miss it.
